prompts.name: accounts-ar
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity readable desktop ERP application screen, 1600x1000 landscape, flat straight-on screenshot, no device mockup. This is one of a coordinated set of serious accountant workbenches for ODIN ERP. Exact palette: accent #245DE8, hover #1545BD, navy #102747, white #FFFFFF, outer background #F4F7FC, muted #53647B, borders #DCE4EF. Typography Manrope English, Noto Sans Arabic Arabic; numeric tabular Western digits, all account codes isolated LTR. Crisp 14px body, 12px labels, 28px title, 40px financial rows, 6px control radius, 1px borders, minimal shadow. Keep a 200px navy navigation rail and white topbar with current branch, language selector and user. Above navy rail is a clean WHITE original-brand logo region; reserve this region completely blank, do not draw any logo, letters or invented mark. Shared nav entries: Overview, Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, Accounting, Reports, Settings (use Arabic equivalents in Arabic screen). Accounting active blue. Main content begins 24px from shell. Accounting sub-navigation across content top: Accounts, Journals, Ledger, Trial balance, Financial statements; use Arabic equivalents in Arabic screen. No marketing hero, decorative illustration, metric-card grid, gradient, rounded pill or fake capability. All UI is practically implementable as native HTML/CSS with semantic controls and simple 18px line icons. Do not render source code or design annotations.
Full PRIMARY SCREEN 1: Arabic RTL chart of accounts, main navy navigation on RIGHT side. Title right: "دليل الحسابات" and small honest description "هيكل الحسابات والتصنيف وإعدادات الترحيل". Primary blue "إضافة حساب" left of title, secondary "توسيع الكل". Below accounting tabs build ONE large workbench, no detached cards. Toolbar: "بحث بالرمز أو اسم الحساب", select "كل الأنواع", select "كل الحالات". Workbench split: right 72% true hierarchical tree-table, left 28% selected-account inspector, separated by vertical border. Table headers RTL: "الحساب", "النوع", "المستوى", "الحالة". Account tree shows nested rows with indents, fine tree connector lines and separate disclosure icons: 1000 الأصول (مجموعة), 1100 الأصول المتداولة (مجموعة), 1110 النقدية والبنوك (مجموعة), 1111 الخزينة الرئيسية (ترحيل), 1112 البنك الرئيسي (ترحيل, selected pale blue), 1120 العملاء (ترحيل), 1200 الأصول الثابتة (مجموعة), 2000 الالتزامات (مجموعة collapsed), 3000 حقوق الملكية (مجموعة collapsed), 4000 الإيرادات (مجموعة collapsed), 5000 المصروفات (مجموعة collapsed). Account-code column narrow and perfectly aligned LTR, account names directly beside code with real levels. Type column shows أصول for asset rows. State text "نشط" plain muted with small dot, no pills. Selected row has blue edge accent. Inspector heading "البنك الرئيسي", code1112 large but restrained, type assets; definition list: "الحساب الأب" 1110 — النقدية والبنوك, "نوع الحساب" أصول, "طبيعة الحساب" مدين, "قابل للترحيل" نعم, "الحالة" نشط. Horizontal divider then buttons "تعديل الحساب", "كشف الحساب", "إضافة حساب فرعي". Lower inspector short text "تظهر الحركة في كشف الحساب حسب الفترة والفرع المحددين." Keep enough room below tree to imply scroll; footer shows "11 حسابًا" and "الحسابات النشطة". The display must be usable and sophisticated for daily accounting work.

accountsFinalRefinement: Produce a fresh complete primary-screen variation using this same design system, prioritizing clear hierarchy. CRITICAL: this must visibly read as an actual TREE, not a flat table. In the main right tree column, draw pale vertical connector lines and horizontal short elbows from right to left. Root1000 begins at right edge; child1100 starts24px fartherLEFT; grandchild1110 starts48px fartherLEFT; leaves1111 and1112 start72px fartherLEFT. Children MUST be visibly indented together with their code and name; avoid aligning all account codes to one flat right edge. 1111 and1112 have level4 (not3). 1120islevel3; 1200islevel2. A dedicated typecolumn displays assetclassification أصول for all assetrows, and nextcolumn shows مجموعة or ترحيل. The tree connector lines and24px discrete indentation at every level are mandatory and central to this concept. Selected1112rowbackgroundlightblue continues across columns, thin blue accent at RIGHT edge of tree row. Keep everything coherent.
notes: Original logo is deliberately omitted from generated concepts and must be supplied from the verified repository asset in production.
Example figures are concept-only; all runtime values must come from real authorized API results.
Account tree final is accounts-tree-ar.png; accounts-ar.png is the superseded first pass.
